basic_physical_attack.description: Standard melee/ranged weapon strikes. Pure ATK scaling with 0% INT dependence.

pure_caster_ability.formula: round((INT * Ability_Mult * INT_mod) * Pathway_Tuning * Seq_Mult - Defender_DEF * 0.5)
pure_caster_ability.description: Spiritual, elemental, and metaphysical magic spells funded by SP.
pure_caster_ability.def_armor_penetration: 25% DEF bypass (Psychic True DMG bypasses 100% DEF)

empowered_hybrid_physical.description: Physical strikes imbued with spirituality (e.g. Sailor, Guardian, Reaper).

empowered_hybrid_agility.description: Agile, high-speed strikes with spiritual finesse (e.g. Marauder, Nightwalker, Witch).

def_armor_mitigation.description: Physical armor and defensive stats subtract half of DEF value from non-penetrating damage.

mythical_creature_form_rules.trigger: Automatic: triggers the moment current HP <= hp_threshold * Max HP, on any unit's turn (including incoming damage and damage-over-time), not only on the character's own turn.

stance_buffs.mental_pollution_aura: On transformation, 20% chance each enemy loses its next turn.

mythical_creature_form_rules.casting_rule: FULL ABILITY CASTING PERMITTED WHILE TRANSFORMED. Mythical Form acts as an active stance buff and does not disable skills.
